item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2023 evidence that Putin appointed new top economic professionals to replace loyalists or that he materially expanded technocratic autonomy. The best evidence is continuity: he kept Nabiullina, Siluanov, Reshetnikov, Mishustin, and Oreshkin in the decision loop and sometimes let them push orthodox macro policy. But the dominant pattern in 2023 was still war mobilization, patriotic pressure on business, and regime stability, not a clean competence-first economic appointment strategy.","evidence":[{"title":"Russia’s central bank on Friday warned that further widening of the country's budget deficit may compel it to raise interest rates","publisher":"Reuters","date":"10 Feb 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russian-central-bank-holds-key-rate-at-75-gives-hawkish-signal-3000569","summary":"Strongest pro-side item: Nabiullina publicly warned about deficit and inflation risks, which indicates real macroeconomic technocracy rather than pure ideological cheerleading. This suggests Putin allowed some professional economic constraint at least on monetary policy.","question_ids":["5B.2"]},{"title":"Putin held a meeting on economic issues with the government and Central Bank on 17 January 2023","publisher":"President of Russia / Kremlin","date":"17 Jan 2023","url":"https://www.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/70364","summary":"Putin convened his core economic team, including the government and Central Bank, to discuss key indicators and “concrete measures” for 2023 development goals. This is weak but real evidence that he continued to rely on technocratic economic officials rather than replacing them with obvious loyalist ideologues.","question_ids":["5B.2"]},{"title":"Russian officials seek to streamline budget spending, but disagree on tax hikes","publisher":"Reuters","date":"15 Jun 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/russian-officials-seek-to-streamline-budget-spending-but-disagree-on-tax-hikes-3106392","summary":"Shows Finance Minister Siluanov, Economy Minister Reshetnikov, and presidential adviser Oreshkin openly debating budget strategy, taxes, and investment effects. That is evidence of technocrats participating in policy, but also of Putin presiding over a war budget that they could only try to manage, not redirect.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Russia should not take temporary control of foreign banks' units - central bank","publisher":"Reuters","date":"28 Apr 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russia-should-not-take-temporary-control-of-foreign-banks-units-central-bank-3067714","summary":"Nabiullina publicly opposed a more arbitrary seizure of foreign bank assets, showing a professional economic official resisting the most politicized instincts of the wartime state. This supports the idea that some competent professionals still had room to act.","question_ids":["5B.2"]},{"title":"Putin says Russia faces big economic challenges, must keep inflation in check","publisher":"Reuters","date":"22 Aug 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-says-russias-economy-can-cope-with-higher-defence-spending-on-war-3159121","summary":"Putin told the government and central bank to keep inflation under control while preparing for the next election. This shows he still used technocratic channels, but the frame was electoral stability and war financing, not independent economic stewardship for its own sake.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Putin tells Russia's billionaires to put patriotism before profit","publisher":"Reuters","date":"16 Mar 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/putin-urges-russias-billionaires-to-invest-in-face-of-sanctions-war-3032372","summary":"Putin’s message to business elites was explicitly political and patriotic: invest at home, support society, and prioritize the state over profit. That cuts against the idea that he was building an autonomous, competence-led economic order.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Putin urges business leaders to build new Russian economy","publisher":"Reuters","date":"16 Mar 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/putin-urges-business-leaders-to-build-new-russian-economy-3032308","summary":"The rhetoric sounds developmental, but it is still framed as mobilizing business for wartime resilience under sanctions rather than empowering independent economic professionals. It is best read as managed state-directed adaptation.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Russian officials emphasise unity after aborted mutiny","publisher":"Reuters","date":"26 Jun 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/russian-officials-emphasise-unity-after-aborted-mutiny/1643200/","summary":"Mishustin called for unity and loyalty after the Wagner mutiny, which reinforces that the cabinet operated inside a regime-survival frame. That weakens any claim that economic professionals were empowered primarily as autonomous policy makers.","question_ids":["5B.2"]},{"title":"The rise and stagnation of Russia's economy during Putin's tenure","publisher":"Reuters","date":"8 Dec 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/the-rise-and-stagnation-of-russias-economy-during-putins-tenure-3252925","summary":"Broad background evidence: Russia’s living-standard gains came from earlier oil-fueled growth, while the current model had stagnated. This is not a direct appointment claim, but it supports the reading that 2023 policy was operating on inherited technocratic capacity rather than a renewed competence-first reform agenda.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]}]}
